notes: Prism 2.2.2: your tasks now sync across devices, like your notes and folders already do — sign in anywhere and they follow you, and only you can see them. A note that's still transcribing now shows a single smooth shimmer instead of blinking placeholder bars. Same private transcription: your audio is never stored, and calls up to three hours transcribe in one go. Free. Requires internet for transcription and notes; recording still works offline.
